en.title: Painel Gods Marketplace
en.summary: Multi-vendor digital marketplace with Pix split payments, seller dashboards, dispute holds, and moderated listings.
en.challenge: Configure a legally/financially safe multi-vendor marketplace on the client’s hosting where Pix split sends funds to seller subaccounts and only commission hits the platform CNPJ — with retention windows for MED/refunds and manual listing approval.
en.solution: Structured WordPress + WooCommerce + Dokan/WCFM vendor panels, chat, moderation workflow, and split-payment gateway configuration (Asaas/Iugu). UX emphasizes trust, speed, and clear seller/buyer journeys.
en.results: A marketplace money-flow the owner can defend: Pix split to sellers, commission only on the platform CNPJ, retention for disputes, and moderated listings before they go live.
highlights: Native Pix split to seller subaccounts
Manual listing moderation for quality control

pt.solution: WordPress + WooCommerce + Dokan/WCFM, chat, moderação e gateway de split (Asaas/Iugu). UX focada em confiança, velocidade e jornadas claras.
pt.results: Fluxo financeiro de marketplace defensável: split Pix aos vendedores, comissão só no CNPJ da plataforma, carência para disputas e anúncios moderados antes de publicar.

zh.title: Painel Gods 多商户市场
zh.summary: 支持 Pix 分账、卖家后台、争议冻结与人工审核上架的多商户数字市场。
zh.role: 市场架构 · 支付 · 卖家体验
zh.challenge: 在客户自有主机上构建法律与资金安全的多商户市场：Pix 分账至卖家子账户，平台仅收佣金，并设置冻结期与人工审核。
zh.solution: 配置 WordPress + WooCommerce + Dokan/WCFM、聊天、审核流程与分账网关，强调信任与效率。
zh.results: 可辩护的市场资金流：Pix 分账至卖家、平台 CNPJ 仅收佣金、争议冻结，以及上线前人工审核。
highlights: 多商户后台与站内聊天
Pix 原生分账至卖家子账户
退款/争议余额冻结规则
